# Toggle

An on/off switch with a check mark in the thumb, so the state never depends on colour alone.

`CLR.Toggle` · Controls

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.Toggle checked onChange={…} label="…" />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.Toggle" checked="{{yes}}" on-change="{{…}}" label="…"></x-import>
```

## Props (ToggleProps)

| prop | type | note |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `checked` * | `boolean` |  |
| `onChange` * | `(checked: boolean) => void` |  |
| `label` * | `string` | Required: used as the accessible name even when visually hidden. |
| `description` | `string` | Second line in the row layout. |
| `row` | `boolean` | Full-width row with label on the left (Settings). |
| `disabled` | `boolean` |  |
